01
Bounce Rate Problem
Mobile visitors lost before they ever see your offer
According to Google Gemini Research The average mobile bounce rate for mortgage company websites falls between 52% and 63%. Mobile bounce rates run 10–15% higher than desktop due to distraction, slow load times, and forms not optimized for small screens. Visitors who find the page takes more than 2–3 seconds to load on mobile are significantly more likely to leave immediately. For most mortgage sites, more than half of every dollar spent on traffic is lost before a visitor sees the first page.

02
Form Abandonment Problem
Interested visitors who start a form — then disappear
According to Google Gemini Research The average form abandonment rate for mortgage websites is exceptionally high — typically 68% to 75%, the highest in the financial services sector. Nearly half of all digital financial applications are abandoned because the process is too long, asks for unexpected documents, or uses overwhelming financial jargon. Consumers typically abandon if a form takes longer than 5–10 minutes without a save option. Demanding sensitive data like SSNs early — before trust is established — causes significant additional dropout.

AI Sales Assistant — Tess
Video testimonials · Smart screens · Pre-qual interviews · 24/7 closing
According to Google Gemini Research When AI sales assistants are effectively implemented, they guide buyers through the decision-making process, provide immediate answers to reduce hesitation, and qualify leads around the clock. Research documents conversion boosts of 50% to 400% across financial services verticals. Key drivers include: immediate 24/7 responses that prevent visitors from leaving to find competitors, automated lead qualification outside business hours, personalized recommendations based on visitor behavior, and reduced cart/form abandonment through real-time engagement. The average mortgage website captures only 3 leads per 100 visitors — AI assistants directly address this gap.
